title: On Air presence counts include practice logs beyond the 1,000-row API cap
detail: The presence query requested up to 10,000 practice_logs rows in one Data API response, but the hosted PostgREST max_rows setting is 1,000. On busy days the member-facing distinct-practitioner total silently omitted everyone after the response cap. It now reads stable ordered pages to completion, counts distinct non-null profile ids, and returns no partial count if a page fails.

verify.evidence: Regression tests read more than 1,000 rows across ordered pages, dedupe profiles across the boundary, enforce the requested local date filter, cover the exact-cap empty-page case, and reject partial counts on a later-page error.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const f=require("node:fs");const a=f.readFileSync("lib/on-air/practice-presence.ts","utf8");const s=f.readFileSync("lib/on-air/session-data.ts","utf8");const t=f.readFileSync("lib/on-air/practice-presence.test.ts","utf8");process.exit(!a.includes(".order(\u0027id\u0027")||!a.includes(".range(from, from + PRACTICE_PRESENCE_PAGE_SIZE - 1)")||!s.includes("countPracticedToday(admin")||!t.includes("PRACTICE_PRESENCE_PAGE_SIZE + 1")||!t.includes("later page fails")?1:0)'
